description: This file defines a class GatedLLMContextAggregator, which is a specialized frame processor designed to control the flow of LLM context frames based on an external notifier. It manages incoming frames, gating certain frames until notified, and handles starting and stopping a gating task.

classes.name: GatedLLMContextAggregator
classes.description: A frame processor that gates LLM context frames until a notifier signals for their release. It controls the flow of context frames, useful in scenarios requiring external condition-based message control.

methods.name: __init__(self, *, notifier: BaseNotifier, start_open: bool = False, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the gated context aggregator with a notifier, optional start-open flag, and additional keyword arguments.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, gating LLM context frames, handling start/end/cancel frames, and managing the start-open state.

methods.name: _start(self)
methods.description: Creates and starts the gate task handler coroutine.

methods.name: _stop(self)
methods.description: Stops and cancels the gate task handler coroutine if active.

methods.name: _gate_task_handler(self)
methods.description: Asynchronous handler that waits for notifications and releases the last gated context frame when triggered.
